ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Damaged twin-arm streetlight with missing luminaires and exposed wiring
DETAILS: The photo shows the top of a decorative two-arm streetlight against a bright, clear daytime sky. The left arm is missing its luminaire/fixture completely with electrical wire sticking out, while the right arm is missing its protective globe/casing, leaving a bare bulb exposed. The user note is empty.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Traffic Operations
WHY: West 86th Street is a city roadway located in Manhattan, New York City. The New York City Department of Transportation maintains the public streetlight system across all city streets.
